prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1047; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a vehicle that failed to yield at the stop sign. Police report requested. Initial call made to claimant, who reports neck pain and stiffness with onset later that day. Claimant is not represented by counsel at this time.

Entry 2: Recorded statement obtained from claimant. Claimant describes being stopped at the light when the impact occurred, with head snapping sideways and then forward. Reports headache and limited range of motion in neck. Has not yet seen a physician. Advised claimant of the medical evaluation process and that a copy of the police report is pending. Claimant indicated they would seek treatment this week.

Entry 3: Claimant provided urgent care discharge paperwork. Diagnosis listed as cervical strain consistent with whiplash injury. Prescribed muscle relaxants and physical therapy referral. Reviewed records against the loss description and the photos of the vehicle damage, which show consistent impact points. No discrepancies noted at this stage. Requested itemized medical bills and prior treatment history for the neck and upper back.

Entry 4: Follow-up call with claimant to confirm physical therapy schedule and ask about missed work. Claimant reports ongoing discomfort when turning the head to check blind spots while driving. Explained the rental vehicle coverage terms and the process for submitting wage documentation. Claimant still has no legal representation and says they have not contacted an attorney. Sent written summary of next steps by mail.

Entry 5: Received police report and independent appraisal of the insured and claimant vehicles. Liability appears clear based on the report citing the other driver for failure to yield. Physical therapy progress notes received and show gradual improvement in range of motion. Medical file is still open pending final bills and a current treatment update. Scheduled reserve review and will reassess once the treatment plan is finalized.
